description: Fetch a single bill with full detail: versions, sponsorships, related/companion bills, actions, and votes. Pass the OpenStates ID (e.g., "ocd-bill/abc...") or a state/session/identifier triple.

session.description: Session ID, per state (Ohio "136", California "20252026"); a year or year range is resolved to the state's session. Use with jurisdiction + identifier.

name: get_bill
